tagline: 潘泰康胶片相机，1978 年发布
description: 潘泰康于1978年推出的胶片相机。快门速度B, 1/1, 1/2, 1/4, 1/8, 1/15 1/30, 1/60, 1/125, 1/250,1/500.。使用Quick-release lever, Pentacon Loading-System, fold-out rewind crank, auto-zeroing frame counter.。

specs.快门: Mechanically controlled vertical-moving metal-blade focal plane shutter.
specs.取景器: Fixed eye-level viewfinder (Pentaprism) with Fresnel lens with microprism and split-image range-finder as focusing screen, needle metering indication with (+/-)-symbol.
specs.胶片/画幅: Quick-release lever, Pentacon Loading-System, fold-out rewind crank, auto-zeroing frame counter.
specs.曝光测光: TTL-metering using stopped-down metering controlled by a switch beside the lens mount above the shutter release knob.
specs.闪光灯: X-Synchronisation (1/125), accessory shoe at the top of the pentaprism, coaxial flash socket at the camera body for dual flash systems.
specs.英文简介: The Praktica Super TL 3 was introduced in March 1978, showing no fundamental changes when compared to its predecessors.
